name: smwgraphics-mario-party-advance-switch-way
title: Mario Party Advance - Switch Way?
description:
The BG from the Mario Party Advance Mini-Game "Switch Way?".

The Layer 2 BG Scrolling Rate must be set to "H-Scroll: Constant, V-Scroll: None" for the BG to work correctly.

Credit would be nice but you don't have to.
